title: Mock Pooling
author: Opentrons
materials: Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Gather required hardware and consumables
steps.instruction: Ensure you have an Opentrons OT‑2 robot with the OT‑2 Run App (Version 3.19.0 or later), a Multi‑Channel p300 electronic pipette, and p300 tips. Use a 2 mL 96‑well plate and a single tube for the pooled sample, and operate only the rear‑most channel of the p300 multichannel pipette.

steps.title: Enter pooling parameters
steps.instruction: In the protocol interface, provide a comma‑separated list of source wells with no spaces (e.g., "A1,B2,C3"), specify the row‑column location of the pool tube (e.g., "A1"), answer "YES" if the same tip should be used for all aspirates, and enter the well‑bottom clearance (in mm) for both aspirate and dispense steps.

steps.title: Download protocol
steps.instruction: Click the “Download your protocol” button to save the generated protocol file to your computer.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT App
steps.instruction: Open the OT‑2 Run App, select “Upload protocol”, and load the downloaded protocol file.

steps.title: Arrange deck as per map
steps.instruction: Place the 2 mL 96‑well plate and the destination tube on the deck positions indicated in the provided deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Using the OT‑2 Run App, run the calibration routine for the tip rack, the 96‑well plate, the destination tube, and the p300 pipette. Use calibration tips as described in the support article.

steps.title: Run the protocol
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT‑2 Run App to start the automated pooling of 20 µL aliquots from the designated wells into the single tube using the rear‑most channel of the p300 multichannel pipette.
